spanish: Y después así entrarán los levitas a servir tienda de reunión, y limpiarás a ellos y los balancearás balanceo.

findings.issue: Hiphil H5130 plus cognate H8573 licenses a to-and-fro wave; balancear/balanceo also means equilibrate, so that motion is not the only reading.

notes: Person, number, piel/hiphil force, cognate object, and clause order match the tokens.
